name: 77038 · Houston, TX
findings: ZIP 77038 (Houston) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (75% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77038 (Houston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 77038 (Houston) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 60% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 8 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 60% of all organizations here have no identified type.
